digitalocean.content:
- name: Create DigitalOcean cloud-controller secret without writing it to disk
  ansible.builtin.command: kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf apply -f -
  args:
    stdin: |
      apiVersion: v1
      kind: Secret
      metadata:
        name: digitalocean
        namespace: kube-system
      stringData:
        access-token: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'COLORS_PAR_DO_TOKEN') }}"
  register: digitalocean_secret
  changed_when: "'created' in digitalocean_secret.stdout or 'configured' in digitalocean_secret.stdout"
  no_log: true

- name: Download pinned DigitalOcean cloud controller
  ansible.builtin.get_url:
    url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/digitalocean/digitalocean-cloud-controller-manager/@VERSION@/releases/digitalocean-cloud-controller-manager/@VERSION@.yml"
    dest: "/root/digitalocean-ccm-@VERSION@.yml"
    mode: "0644"

- name: Apply DigitalOcean cloud controller
  ansible.builtin.command: >-
    kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf apply
    -f /root/digitalocean-ccm-@VERSION@.yml
  register: ccm_apply
  changed_when: "'created' in ccm_apply.stdout or 'configured' in ccm_apply.stdout"

- name: Bind DigitalOcean load balancers to the deployment-owned VPC
  ansible.builtin.command: >-
    kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf -n kube-system
    set env deployment/digitalocean-cloud-controller-manager
    DO_CLUSTER_VPC_ID=@NETWORK_ID@
  register: ccm_vpc
  changed_when: "'updated' in ccm_vpc.stdout"

- name: Wait for DigitalOcean cloud controller after VPC configuration
  ansible.builtin.command: >-
    kubectl --kubeconfig=/etc/kubernetes/admin.conf -n kube-system
    rollout status deployment/digitalocean-cloud-controller-manager --timeout=300s
  changed_when: false
